title: The Evidence data (/connected/snapshot) returns the server's absolute workspace path, which the page never uses and /connected/library already strips.
expected: FINDINGS-SCHEMA severity High ("a leaked secret or path") and README rule R3 (a leaked path is always repaired); D-05 (no local path on any page); the sibling endpoint _library_index (react_frontend/__init__.py:104-116) deliberately returns only catalogue.real.
actual: GET /connected/snapshot and /connected/snapshot?run=<run> both return catalogue.workspace = "/tmp/cs-C5/root/_engine" (src/deploy_workflow/credit_os_catalogue.py:517 `"workspace": str(workspace)`). No client code reads the field (grep of web/src/pages/connected finds none); the path is not drawn, but it is in every response the Evidence tabs and trace drawers load. It is the only absolute path in the response. Exposure is limited to the browser of the person running the service on loopback, so the lead may moderate the severity.
suggested_change: Drop "workspace" from the catalogue the snapshot route returns (or from the exported dict), as _library_index already does; keep the field only for server-side use.

screen: /report/20261117-072535-01#evidence/gaps and /report/20261117-072535-01#evidence/trace (partial: gap rows and an earlier run injected by request interception; 390 px)
title: At 390 px the Gaps ledger and the Comparison measures table push every card on the tab past the window edge, and the report area scrolls sideways.
expected: D-42 (content reflows without loss at narrow widths) and D-32 (long text wraps; no horizontal scrolling for prose); the table wrappers are meant to scroll (Evidence.tsx:257 `overflow-x-auto`).
actual: With three ordinary gap rows the Gaps card is 567 px wide in a 390 px window (main scrollWidth 583 > 390), the intro sentence is cut at the right edge and the table wrapper never scrolls (wrapperScrolls=false). With an earlier run, the Trace tab's Comparison measures table makes the Handoffs card 585 px wide (the download buttons are cut off). Cause: the Evidence root is `grid min-w-0 gap-5` with an auto column (Evidence.tsx:662; Record.tsx root and ScriptChecks the same), so the column grows to the widest table; ReportContent.tsx uses grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] for the same job. The synthetic fixture has no gap rows and no comparison, so no overflow shows in the 25 real-data Evidence screens (overflow-390-all.cjs: 0 of 25).
suggested_change: Give the Evidence root (and the Record root) `grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)]` so a card is never wider than the window and its table wrapper scrolls inside it; add `wrap-anywhere` to the Gaps detail cell and to the Script check titles.

title: The trace drawer of the Confidence score lists 14 identical "no page" entries instead of the confidence inputs it is computed from.
expected: CM-080 and CM-216: the inputs table is audit material shown on Evidence; CM-079: the drawer shows the claim, then its derivation. buildTrace carries a branch for exactly this case ("The score is computed from the handoff's own inputs table: show its rows as written", ReportContent.tsx:178-182).
actual: "Show sources for this figure" on the Confidence score opens "Confidence inputs", statement "Confidence inputs", and under "How it was derived" 14 repeats of "no page / the row cites no page or register". None of Directly Sourced 8, Fields present 95, Source gate pass, CRITICAL 0 appears. The rows branch only runs when `!basis && !chips.length`, but the service attaches one "no page" chip per table row, so it never runs for this table. The same 14 entries and no inputs open in the Confidence score drawers of all 14 modules (15 of 15 opened); 103 of 250 drawers contain a "no page" entry.
suggested_change: For the Confidence inputs table, draw its rows in the derivation whatever chips exist, and drop gap chips that only say a row cites no page.

title: Every Forecast figure that traces to the forward model opens the same drawer: one fixed sentence and "Recorded forecast inputs", with no per-figure derivation.
expected: CM-074 and CM-069: each calculated figure opens its steps in the trace drawer; D-06 (the drawer shows the figure's source, page and calculation steps where the handoff carries them).
actual: 12 of the 26 trace controls on Forecast (Model scope qualification x3, Base case, Downside shock, Cash flow model, Cash proxy by scenario x3, Revenue, Closing cash, Closing debt) open "Forecast inputs (machine-readable)", "Forward credit model - Handoff line 93", statement "The model calculation uses the inputs recorded in this handoff.", derivation "Recorded forecast inputs", and nothing says which figure was asked about. "Open in Evidence" lands on one raw one-line JSON dump in a <pre> (with the literal ```json fence) for line 93.
suggested_change: Point each Forecast figure at the row or calculation that produced it (calculation JSON id or the forecast table row), or state in the drawer that the figure comes from the model run and name its inputs; render the inputs as a table, not raw JSON.

title: The page-level "Show sources" switch changes state on every Evidence tab but there is nothing for it to reveal.
expected: SourcesSwitch/TraceButton: the switch shows the trace controls (TraceControl.tsx `in-data-[sources=on]`); a control must have an effect.
actual: On all 7 Evidence screens tried the switch flips data-sources off/on and the checkbox state, and 0 trace controls exist (traceControls=0 before and after), so nothing changes. Evidence draws no trace control by design (the drawer's "Open in Evidence" lands here). The strict reading of FINDINGS-SCHEMA ("a control that does nothing ... on an ordinary path") would make this High; Medium because the switch is harmless and shared with the other report tabs.
suggested_change: Hide or disable the switch on the Evidence tab (with a visible reason), or give Evidence something it controls. Owner decision: it removes a control the reader sees on that tab.

title: ArrowDown/ArrowUp on the closed Module select navigates immediately and adds a history entry for every key press.
expected: D-35 and WCAG 3.2.2: choosing a value must not change the page until the user commits it; Back should not need one press per arrow key.
actual: Focusing the select and pressing ArrowDown five times went to #evidence/sources/CP-0, CP-1, CP-1A, CP-2, CP-2A in turn and added 5 history entries (history.length +5); five Back presses were needed to return. The onChange handler calls window.location.assign for every change (Evidence.tsx:548-552). A keyboard user reaching "Research questions" from "All modules" causes 14 route changes.
suggested_change: Use the kit Select (commit on Enter/click) or navigate on blur/Enter, and use location.replace so one filter change is one history entry.

title: Handoff tables with fewer than five columns scroll sideways at 390 px but cannot be reached or scrolled with the keyboard.
expected: D-35 and WCAG 2.1.1 (axe scrollable-region-focusable): a scrollable region must be keyboard focusable; ReportContent.tsx:260 says a wide table "is a named, focusable region so the keyboard can reach it".
actual: PublishedTable sets tabIndex and role=region only when `columns.length >= 5` (ReportContent.tsx:261-266). In the Financial foundation handoff view at 390 px, 3 of 18 table regions (the 4-column Chart data tables) scroll sideways and are not focusable; axe reports scrollable-region-focusable x3. The component is C3's (ReportContent.tsx); the screen is C5's.
suggested_change: Make the wrapper focusable (tabIndex 0, role region, name) whenever it can overflow, not by column count.

title: Every handoff evidence view draws the handoff's title as a bare module-code heading ("CP-1" ... "CP-DR"), next to the module name in the card title.
expected: D-13 part 1 and Amendment 2026-11-12: no module code as a heading or label on any page, Evidence included; the card is already titled "Financial foundation - Handoff evidence".
actual: 14 of 14 handoff views show an h3 that is only the code (CP-0 ... CP-DR), first under the card title, above "Sources" and "Findings". The code is the handoff's level-1 title, which classifySections gives the "registers" role, so EvidenceLocation draws it (Evidence.tsx:57-75). Codes inside module-written text, file names and hashes are allowed as stored; this heading is neither.
suggested_change: Skip the level-1 title section in EvidenceLocation (or draw moduleName); the card heading already names the module.

title: The handoff evidence view looks like rendered Markdown: literal "- " bullets with 64-hex hashes in the body font, handoff section names as headings, and (on a forecast line) a literal ```json fence.
expected: D-04 (nothing looks extracted directly from Markdown; no literal bullets or fences; handoff section names are not visible headings), D-30 (mono for hashes on Evidence).
actual: Across the 14 handoff views, 130 paragraphs begin with a literal "- " and 118 of them are "- <name> <64-hex hash>" lines (Sources section drawn as raw paragraphs, hashes not in mono); headings "Sources", "Findings", "Bottom line", "Key findings" are the handoff's own; the Forecast inputs line view prints the ```json fence and the whole JSON as one line. The tables are fine (585 of 585 table rows equal the delivered Markdown, evidence-table-fidelity.cjs).
suggested_change: Draw the Sources section as the SourceFileRow list (name, type, hash in mono), strip list markers and the code fence, and show the forecast inputs as a table.

title: The Gaps ledger is not grouped or ordered by severity.
expected: CM-075 and CM-236/254/262/285: "Gap ledger grouped by stated severity" (R13 RegisterTable grouped by severity).
actual: Five gaps entered as Low, High, Medium, Low, High are drawn in that order in one flat table with a Severity column and no group headings (0 group elements). EvidenceGaps flat-maps the entries with no sort or grouping (Evidence.tsx:240-245). With many gaps across 14 modules the reader must scan for the High rows.
suggested_change: Group by severity (High, Medium, Low, then unstated) with a count per group, keeping the module and the Open source link per row.

title: Evidence > Sources opens the supplied source files (the workbook downloads), although ruling decision 9 says files are "listed only, not downloadable or viewable".
expected: docs/rulings/2026-11-11-reader-and-issuer-report.md decision 9 ("listed only, not downloadable or viewable"); retired.md R-24; harmony-report H-02 left the question to the owner.
actual: Each source row has "Open source file: <name>" (target=_blank). The service answers 200 with the file bytes for /connected/sources/<run>/<sha>/<name>: text/plain for the two .txt files, application/octet-stream for northbridge-portfolio.xlsx, which downloads and leaves a blank tab behind. ?page=N returns a text extract. Source links also appear in the trace drawer when a chip carries one (none in the synthetic data). Excel is an input format only (AGENTS.md); offering the workbook back is the same question.
suggested_change: none: the owner decides whether source files may be opened (H-02). If not, drop SourceFileLinks from Sources and the drawer; if yes, send the ruling text an amendment and serve the xlsx as a download with Content-Disposition.

title: "Model and calculation files" shows its heading and nothing else while the listing loads, and stays blank for good if the reply has no files array.
expected: D-31: loading is a skeleton or label, not a blank card; errors and empty replies each have a message (ArtifactDownloads.tsx already has them for 500 and for an empty list).
actual: With the listing delayed 6 s the card shows only the heading (no status role, no aria-busy). With a 200 reply of {} the card shows only the heading indefinitely: `data.files` is undefined, `value` stays undefined and none of the three messages renders (ArtifactDownloads.tsx:16-18, 27-39). 500 and {"files":[]} are handled.
suggested_change: Draw a "Loading the model and calculation files…" line (role=status) while pending, and treat a reply without a files array as the error case.

title: Handoff, calculation and Model downloads are on Summary and Trace, and registers and confidence inputs are drawn per handoff on Trace, not on Record as the matrix places them.
expected: CM-018, CM-069, CM-076, CM-212..CM-314 and CT-048: handoffs, "download all", calculation JSON and Model downloads, registers, confidence inputs, calls, timings and instructions are on Evidence > Record; ruling decisions 9 and 10 list downloads under Evidence and run internals under "Run record".
actual: Record shows run type, elapsed, cap usage, per-module steps/calls/instruction downloads and file hashes only. Downloads sit on Summary (and handoff downloads on Trace); registers (T-tables), Confidence inputs, Calculations and Gaps appear only inside a handoff's Trace view as plain tables, not the sortable register table the matrix names. Bytes of all 14 handoffs, the zip and the three artifacts equal the delivered files.
suggested_change: none: the owner decides which of the matrix (Record) and the ruling text (Evidence lists) governs; then move the downloads or correct the matrix.

title: Script check cards are titled "columns", "rows", "all" or "Headroom: all", and draw the service's raw markup, snake_case register names and module codes.
expected: D-16 (headings carry information), D-04 (no literal backticks or ###), D-13 (module codes), CM-077 (results of the method-script checks with their status).
actual: 125 of 215 outcomes have the figure "columns", 70 have "all", 1 has "rows": the card is headed "columns: not checked" (aria-label identical for dozens of cards). Registers read "`### Recovery waterfall`" and "downstream_readiness"; a reason reads "CP-3 states no enterprise value can be supported for Low: `Not supplied: …`". 205 of the 215 are "not checked", 9 agreed, 1 noted.
suggested_change: Title a card by its register and the check ("T4.10 columns present"), and strip backticks and ### from the register and reason strings.

title: Script checks expose 215 region landmarks with duplicate names, and Record tables are all named "Table".
expected: D-37/D-44 (distinct names; decoration and repetition do not flood the landmark list); axe landmark-unique.
actual: Each check card is a <section aria-label="<title>: <status>">, so the page has one landmark per card, many named "columns: not checked"; axe reports landmark-unique (moderate) on checks and checks/CP-4. Record's call tables use PublishedTable without a heading, so their scroll regions are all labelled "Table".
suggested_change: Drop aria-label from the check section (the h4 names it) and pass the module name as the table heading in Record.

title: Record jumps from h3 to h5 ("Synthetic adapter responses" / "Model calls", "Handoff issues").
expected: D-36 (headings in order); axe heading-order.
actual: Module records is an h3 and the headings inside each module are h5 with no h4 (Record.tsx:117, 158); axe reports heading-order on record.
suggested_change: Use h4.

title: The Summary count reads "1 designated handoffs" and gives only two counts.
expected: D-16 (plain, correct copy); CM-078 (what can be verified and how: run identity, source and handoff counts, evidence state at a glance).
actual: "14 designated handoffs · 3 source files" for the whole run and "1 designated handoffs · 3 source files" with a module chosen (Evidence.tsx:396-409). Nothing states the evidence state (gaps, checks run, basis not found), though that is on the other tabs.
suggested_change: Pluralise correctly and add one line each for gaps, script checks and handoffs with an unlocated Basis.

title: Handoff names are links styled as plain semibold labels, so the reader cannot tell they open that handoff's evidence.
expected: D-39 (a link has a cue beyond a hue), D-27 (interactive things look interactive).
actual: The 14 names (and the module names on Trace) have no underline, colour 71,74,79 against 99,103,110 body text, weight 600, and darken on hover only; they sit beside a secondary "Download <name>" button that looks like the main control.
suggested_change: Style them as the text links used elsewhere (underline or brand colour) and add a chevron.

title: In "Model and calculation files" the three download buttons stretch to the full card width.
expected: D-26 (siblings agree: the handoff downloads are content-width buttons), D-23.
actual: Annual model handoff, Calculation JSON and Exact forecast JSON are 1242 x 40 px buttons at 1440 px while the handoff downloads right above are 160 to 260 px wide.
suggested_change: Lay the buttons out with `flex flex-wrap gap-3` (content width).

title: An address naming a module that is not in the run filters the page to nothing while the Module select still reads "All modules".
expected: D-31 / D-35: the visible filter and the shown content agree; an unknown module is reported, not silently applied.
actual: #evidence/summary/NOPE shows "0 designated handoffs · 0 source files", sources/NOPE "No issuer files are listed for NOPE.", checks/NOPE "No script-check record is held for NOPE." (the raw id as the name), gaps/NOPE "No recorded gaps for NOPE.", while select.value is "" ("All modules") in all six.
suggested_change: Treat a module that is not an option as no filter (and keep the tab), or show the unavailable-link alert.

title: ArtifactDownloads draws any href the listing returns, including a foreign https address.
expected: D-10/R8 and the rule used elsewhere ("only links attested by the bridge are drawn": publishedHref and sourceFileLinks validate folder, hash and shape).
actual: A listing of {"files":[{"label":"Evil","href":"https://example.com/x"}]} renders <a href="https://example.com/x" download>; a javascript: href is blocked by React. The listing comes from the local service, so this is defence in depth.
suggested_change: Accept only /connected/artifacts/<folder>/<sha>/<file> hrefs, as publishedHref does for downloads.

title: The Gaps table prints Markdown marks raw ("**bold**", backticks) and labels every row link "Open source" although it opens the handoff line, not a source.
expected: D-04 (no literal **, backticks), D-16 (specific labels), D-37 (the visible label says what the control does).
actual: A gap recorded as text "with **bold** and `code`" is drawn with the asterisks and backticks; the Recorded detail cell uses plainModuleNames only (Evidence.tsx:292-294). The row link "Open source" (Evidence.tsx:296-302) goes to #evidence/<token>-<line>, the handoff line with its derivation.
suggested_change: Draw the detail with richParts and call the link "Open handoff line".

screen: /report/20261117-072535-01#evidence/summary and #evidence/trace (partial: delivery without zip, handoffs and downloads)
title: When the delivery has no zip, handoff links or model files, the page drops the buttons and the section without saying so.
expected: D-31 (an absent thing is stated); CM-018 (one governed download per module and "download all").
actual: With evidence.zip=null, handoffs=[] and downloads=[] the Handoffs card lists module names with no download buttons and no sentence; the Model and calculation card disappears (Evidence.tsx:482-484, 696).
suggested_change: Say "No handoff files were delivered for this run." where the buttons would be.

title: Empty Gaps, Sources and Script checks are one plain sentence, and "Supplied but unnamed in handoffs" / "Use unrecorded" depart from the ruled wording.
expected: D-31 (the designed empty state: icon, title, one sentence); ruling decision 9 ("Supplied, not used"); D-16.
actual: "This run lists no gaps." (Gaps 0), "No issuer files listed in this run's published record." and "No script-check record is held for this run." are bare paragraphs. The Sources groups are "Named in a handoff", "Supplied but unnamed in handoffs" and "Use unrecorded" (Evidence.tsx:656-660); the last is not plain language.
suggested_change: Use the kit empty state and rename the groups "Used by a module", "Supplied, not used" and "Not recorded as used".

title: Drawers and handoff views list "no page / the row cites no page or register" entries that are not tied to a row.
expected: D-01/D-03 (what the reader needs, not repeated machinery); CM-079 (the claim, its derivation and the source row).
actual: 103 of 250 drawers and every handoff view carry runs of identical entries ("no page", "the cell says Not supplied", "p.1 · no key"): 14 in each Confidence inputs drawer, 3 in the Debt maturities drawer. They name no row, so the reader cannot tell which row has no page; where a row says "Not supplied", the cell is already in the table.
suggested_change: Group chips by row and drop "cites no page" entries for tables that have no source column.

title: The service note "the Basis file is not in the CP-0 inventory" puts a module code on the Evidence page and in 14 drawers.
expected: D-13 (module names, not codes, in labels and notes); Amendment 2026-11-16 allows stored module-written text, which this is not.
actual: src/deploy_workflow/credit_os_chips.py:264 writes the sentence; Evidence draws it in EvidenceCitation (Evidence.tsx:144-149) and the drawer in DerivationTree notes, unrewritten. 14 drawers and 12 of the 14 handoff views show "CP-0" in that sentence.
suggested_change: Write "the Source readiness inventory" in the note (or pass it through moduleName).

title: A calculation id defined twice, or nested deeper than 8, silently disappears from a drawer's derivation.
expected: Missing handoff content remains an explicit gap (AGENTS.md); no catch-all that hides a failure.
actual: With rows E1/E1 (duplicate) in the Calculations register and a Basis naming E1, the drawer draws Net debt, Gross debt, Cash (n.a.), Zero example 0, a cycle F1/F2 once, but no E1 node and no note (calculations.ts:24-41 returns [] for duplicates and for depth >= 8). Blank result is "n.a." and zero is 0 as required.
suggested_change: Return a node with a gap value ("defined twice in the handoff") instead of nothing.

title: Record: the run type comes from the service mode, the getRun error text is dropped, and an empty call cell reads "Empty in the handoff".
expected: Evidence honest about the run: Run type from the run's own execution; no catch-all that hides a failure.
actual: Record.tsx:58-59 shows "Synthetic test" whenever the service mode is synthetic, though this run's identity.json records execution "live-provider"; `error` from useResource is only tested for truthiness (Record.tsx:181); PublishedTable shows "—" with aria-label "Empty in the handoff" for a null call field (ReportContent.tsx:313), which is not a handoff.
suggested_change: Use run.execution first, show the error text, and pass an emptyLabel prop to PublishedTable.

title: traceForLine takes an `_index` parameter nothing reads, passed through selectedIndex/index props in three components.
expected: AGENTS.md rewrite-tournament: no props passed and unused.
actual: ReportContent.tsx:221 names the parameter `_index`; Evidence.tsx:174-188 (TraceDetailsView index), 597-631 (EvidenceHandoff selectedIndex) and 653-679 and PublishedTrace.tsx:44 (location.index) exist only to feed it.
suggested_change: Drop the parameter and the three props (stage 6).

title: "Annual model handoff" under "Model and calculation files" is byte-identical to the Financial foundation handoff.
expected: CM-069 / CT-048: calculation JSON and the Model; the Model only where the original asset can be served; H-05.
actual: annual.md (7,136 bytes) equals CP-1.md byte for byte (cmp) and is offered as a third download while the page says "The original HTML Model is unavailable for this run." Labelled honestly, but it is a copy of a handoff already offered above, not the Model.
suggested_change: none: the owner decides whether annual.md is a wanted download.

title: The document title is "Evidence - <issuer> - Credit OS" on every Evidence tab and handoff view; and the shared "Modules 14" tab link has a name that omits its visible text (axe label-content-name-mismatch).
expected: D-37 (the visible label is part of the name); a title that changes with the view.
actual: All 17 addresses tried return the same title. The report nav link has aria-label "Modules 14" over visible text "Modules" + badge 14 on every screen (ReportLibrary.tsx:85-87, owned by C3/S2).
suggested_change: Title "Evidence: Sources - <issuer>"; accessibleLabel "Modules, 14".

title: The stage 0 inventory misses controls on the Evidence screens: 15 trace controls inside closed disclosures, the 14 handoff evidence views, 13 of 14 line-level views and the Open Sources and gap Open source links.
expected: Stage 2 brief: a control missing from the inventory is a finding against stage 0.
actual: clickables.jsonl has 250 trace dialogs for C5 (matches the 250 controls visible without opening a disclosure), but 15 more trace controls exist in closed <details> (forecast 3, Downside 4, Rates FX 4, Security selection 2, Committee decision 2) and were exercised here after opening them; none of the 14 whole-handoff views and one line-level view (CP-6 line 28) were inventoried; the Record "Download instructions" links (14) appear only with the module disclosures open; no gap rows existed, so "Open source" and "Open Sources" were reached by interception.
suggested_change: Open every <details> before collecting; visit each handoff token and one line token per module.

title: Record does not show the delivery or library-admission state, or which outputs were retained rather than newly executed.
expected: CM-092 (delivery without library admission is distinguished from publication; a retained output keeps its original provenance distinct from a newly executed module) and CM-204/CM-117 (execution and delivery states, selected plan, recorded timestamps) on Evidence > Record.
actual: Record draws Run type, Elapsed, Cap usage, then one closed disclosure per module (a two-column Started/Accepted table, the call table, instruction download) and file hashes. There is no delivery or admission line, no marker for retained versus executed outputs, and the module times are a two-column table with no heading, not a timeline of spans.
suggested_change: Add a Delivery line (delivered, admitted to the library, retained from run X) from the run record, and name the Started/Accepted table.

title: After "Open in Evidence" is activated from a drawer, keyboard focus is on the document body, not on the Evidence content.
expected: D-38: if the opener has gone, focus goes to a logical place (the new content or its heading); D-35 (no restart of the Tab order after an in-page navigation).
actual: Opening a drawer with Enter and activating "Open in Evidence" with Enter on Overview, Modules/CP-1 and Forecast left document.activeElement = BODY each time; the next Tab went to "Skip to content" or to the Module select, so a keyboard user must tab through the header again to reach the evidence they asked for. Scroll is handled (the Evidence article is scrolled into view; Back restores the position) and Close/Escape return focus to the opener correctly (265 of 265).
suggested_change: After the hash route resolves to a handoff or line view, focus the article heading (tabIndex -1), as ReportContent does for its findings sections.

screen: /report/20261117-072535-01#evidence/record/<module> (partial: a handoff issue injected by request interception)
title: Record names a module with issues by its output label, which is the module code ("CP-2D · Handoff issues").
expected: D-13 part 1 (module named by its plain name on Evidence too); the same page names modules with moduleName everywhere else.
actual: With an issue on the Liquidity handoff, the Record disclosure for Liquidity shows the heading "CP-2D · Handoff issues" and the issue text; Record.tsx:158 prints output.label, which holds the code in this data; Evidence.tsx:279 and :496 append the same label for a handoff that is not the selected one.
suggested_change: Print moduleName(output.module) and a plain format label ("earlier format").

title: Summary and Trace open on the same "Handoffs" card, so Trace without a handoff chosen adds nothing.
expected: D-03 (one design is not reused for unlike information); CM-072/CM-074 (Trace is where calculation rows expand as a derivation).
actual: #evidence/trace is only the Handoffs card (14 names, 14 downloads, "Download all handoffs"), identical to the card on Summary (Evidence.tsx:633-635, 693-695). The derivation and calculation steps the Trace tab is meant to hold appear only after a handoff or a drawer link is opened.
suggested_change: Show the calculation register or a per-module "what was derived" list on Trace; keep the downloads on Summary.

title: A source with no document date or type is drawn without them and without a marker, so a missing date reads as nothing.
expected: D-14 (a missing value is stated, never silently absent); CM-073 (file name, type, document date, modules that read it).
actual: All three synthetic sources have documentDate null: each row reads "txt · Source readiness · Financial foundation · …" with no date and no "n.a.", and the line is `[type, documentDate, ...readBy].filter(Boolean)` (Evidence.tsx:450-452), so a missing type or date just disappears. Each row also lists all 14 reading modules in one run-on line.
suggested_change: Draw "Document date n.a." in the muted style and collapse the reader list when it names every module ("read by all 14 modules").

title: Evidence nests bordered boxes inside cards: a card per module holding a bordered card per check, a card holding bordered disclosures, a handoff card holding bordered Derivation and citation boxes.
expected: D-21 (no cards inside cards; not every list item in its own bordered box).
actual: Script checks: card (`details className={card}`) > bordered check section per outcome (up to 36 per module) > definition list. Record: card > bordered `details` per module. Handoff view: `article` card > bordered "Derivation" and "Source records" sections and one bordered `li` per citation (14 in the Confidence inputs block alone). Two rounded edges are visible on each (see the screenshots).
suggested_change: Use hairline dividers inside the card instead of boxes; keep one surface per card.

title: hasRecordedGap is exported and tested but no page code calls it; the run folder for a source link is taken by splitting the output id.
expected: AGENTS.md rewrite-tournament and stage 6 (dead code, fragile assumptions); no state or helper set and never read.
actual: Evidence.tsx:378 `export function hasRecordedGap` has no caller outside Evidence.test.tsx (grep of web/src outside Signal). EvidenceCitation (Evidence.tsx:155) and buildTrace (ReportContent.tsx:203) derive the folder with `output.id.split("/")[0]`, so a link is drawn only while the id keeps the "<folder>/deliveries/..." shape (sourceFileLinks compares the bridge href with the one built from that folder, sourceFiles.ts:25-30).
suggested_change: Remove hasRecordedGap and its test (or use it for the Gaps tab count); pass run.folder to EvidenceCitation and buildTrace.
